# A test build rooted at one component leaves its siblings unrendered, and a
# method a sibling calls through a node's `#id` is emitted nowhere: it is no
# call the target has to splice. It used to refuse the whole build.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component counter node {
    var hits = 0
    func bump() {
        hits += 1
    }
    text(value="{hits}")
}

component a node {
    counter #k()
    button #b(text="go", @click { k.bump() })
}

component other node {
    text(value="x")
}

func testA(t Test, c a) {
    c.b.click()
    t.assert(c.k.hits == 1)
}

func testOther(t Test, c other) {
    t.assert(true)
}

window {
    a
    other
}
-- testrun/fyne/go/app.sngl/a/1 --

    }
  ]
}
